content:
{'translation': 'Earlier this year, Twelve South launched its new Valet accessory, describing it as a "wireless charging stand and tray for your personal items."', 'text': '今年較早時，Twelve South 推出了全新的 Valet 配件，並將其形容為「無線充電座兼個人隨身物品托盤」。'}

{'translation': 'Now, Twelve South has expanded the Valet lineup with a smaller version that supports MagSafe and Qi2.2 wireless charging at up to 25W.', 'text': '現在，Twelve South 擴展了 Valet 產品系列，加入一款較細小的版本，支援 MagSafe 及 Qi2.2 無線充電，充電功率最高可達 25W。'}

{'translation': 'The original Valet launched earlier this year measured 7.5 inches, offering enough space to hold a phone, keys, wallet, glasses, and other items. However, the new Valet is significantly smaller at just 4.25 inches.', 'text': '今年較早時推出的第一代 Valet 尺寸為 7.5 吋，空間足以放置手機、鎖匙、銀包、眼鏡等物品。不過，新版 Valet 的體積大幅縮減至 4.25 吋。'}

{'translation': "Here is Twelve South's description of the Valet's premium design:", 'text': '以下是 Twelve South 對 Valet 超頂級設計的描述：'}

{'translation': 'The Valet is designed to be, first and foremost, a beautiful addition to your home, and second, a refined wireless charger. It combines soft materials with modern craftsmanship to create a more calming, intentional shape that fits anywhere in the home—from the entryway console to the kitchen, or the nightstand. The soft square charging pad mirrors the architectural lines of the leather tray, while a weighted zinc alloy base keeps everything stable and organized.', 'text': 'Valet 旨在優先成為一件美觀的家居擺設，其次才是一部精密的無線充電器，融合溫潤的材質與現代工藝，打造出更平靜、更具意念的造型，適用於家中任何位置——從玄關的擺設台、廚房，以至床頭櫃皆宜。柔軟的方形充電板與皮革托盤的建築線條相互呼應，同重鋅合金底座令整體更穩固，亦更井然有序。'}

{'translation': 'On the features front, the smaller Valet still packs plenty of power to charge your iPhone. It also includes an extra USB-C port for charging other accessories:', 'text': '在功能方面，細小的 Valet 擁有充足功率為你的 iPhone 充電。它亦內建一個額外的 USB-C 插口，方便你為其他配件充電：'}

  • {'translation': 'Qi2.2 wireless charging up to 25W', 'text': 'Qi2.2 無線充電，最高 25W'}
  • {'translation': 'Premium Nappa leather tray', 'text': '頂級 Nappa 皮革托盤'}
  • {'translation': 'Four adjustable orientations', 'text': '四種可調校擺放方向'}
  • {'translation': 'Interchangeable, detachable leather trim', 'text': '可互換、可拆式的皮革邊框'}
  • {'translation': 'Weighted zinc alloy base with built-in cable management', 'text': '加重鋅合金底座，內建隱藏式理線設計'}
  • {'translation': 'Extra USB-C port supporting up to 10W wired charging', 'text': '額外 USB-C 插口，支援最高 10W 有線充電'}
  • {'translation': 'Includes 45W power adapter and 1.5m USB-C cable', 'text': '附送 45W 電源供應器及 1.5 米 USB-C 線'}

{'translation': "The 4.25-inch Twelve South Valet is available to order starting today for $129.99 in three color options. While the price is on the higher side, it's undeniably beautiful as a spot to charge your phone while resting your glasses, wallet, or keys.", 'text': '4.25 吋版 Twelve South Valet 即日起接受訂購，售價 129.99 美元，提供三種顏色配搭。價格雖然偏高，但作為放置手機充電，同時又可擺放眼鏡、銀包或鎖匙的所在，確實相當美觀。'}

{'translation': 'Follow Chance: Threads, Bluesky, Instagram, and Mastodon.', 'text': '追蹤 Chance：Threads、Bluesky、Instagram 及 Mastodon。'}
